events.title: Everyone Can Create: Let's Create a Beat! Using GarageBand

cases.refreshed: Have you ever been interested in making your own song? Join us in learning how to make beats and become songwriters! In this program for beginners, we will be using Garage Band to create our own songs with drum pads and Apple Loops. Open to everyone in grades 3-6. Everything needed for this course will be provided, but you are more than welcome to bring your own personal iPad with the free Garage Band app downloaded, especially if you want to save your work. Free. Registration is recommended. This series is taught in English only. Registration closes at 12 PM the day before class. However, if seats are still available, students in grades 3-6 can walk in on Saturday if they arrive before 3 PM to sign in. Maximum class size is 25. Although the class is scheduled from 3-4:30 PM, students who finish their projects early are welcome to leave early. Sábado, 21 de noviembre de 2026 | 3:00–4:30 p.m. ¿Alguna vez has querido crear tu propia canción? ¡Acompáñanos a aprender cómo crear ritmos y convertirte en compositor! En este programa para principiantes, utilizaremos Garage Band para crear nuestras propias canciones con pads de batería y Apple Loops. Dirigido a estudiantes de 3.º a 6.º grado. Todo lo necesario para este curso será proporcionado, pero puedes traer tu propio iPad personal con la aplicación gratuita Garage Band descargada, especialmente si deseas guardar tu trabajo. Gratis. Se recomienda registrarse con anticipación. Esta serie será enseñada únicamente en inglés. La inscripción cierra a las 12 p.m. el día antes de la clase. Si quedan espacios disponibles, los alumnos de grado 3 a 6 pueden venir el sábado e inscribirse antes de las 15:00. La clase tiene un cupo máximo de 25 alumnos. Aunque la clase está programada de 3-4:30 p.m., los alumnos que terminan sus proyectos antes podrán retirarse si lo desean. Tất cả chúng ta đều có thể sáng tạo: Hãy tạo nên nhịp điệu! Sử dụng Garage Band Thứ Bảy, ngày 21 tháng 11 năm 2026, từ 3 - 4:30 giờ chiều Quý vị đã bao giờ muốn tự sáng tác bài hát chưa? Hãy tham gia cùng chúng tôi để học cách tạo beat và trở thành nhạc sĩ! Trong chương trình dành cho người mới bắt đầu này, chúng ta sẽ sử dụng Garage Band để tạo ra những bài hát của riêng mình với những trống và Apple Loops. Lớp học dành cho học sinh lớp 3-6. Mọi thứ cần thiết cho khóa học này sẽ được cung cấp, nhưng bạn hoàn toàn có thể mang theo iPad cá nhân của mình với ứng dụng Garage Band miễn phí đã tải xuống, đặc biệt khi bạn muốn lưu tác phẩm của mình. Miễn phí. Xin vui lòng ghi danh trước. Lớp học được chỉ dạy hoàn toàn bằng tiếng Anh. Thời hạn ghi danh kết thúc vào 12 giờ trưa ngày trước khi lớp học bắt đầu. Tuy nhiên, nếu vẫn còn chỗ trống, học sinh lớp 3-6 có thể đến trực tiếp vào thứ Bảy nếu đến trước 3 giờ chiều để điểm danh. Lớp học tối đa là 25 học sinh. Mặc dù lớp học được lên lịch từ 3 đến 4 giờ 30 chiều, nhưng học sinh nào hoàn thành bài tập sớm có thể về sớm.

cases.refreshed: Join us as Cambrian Branch celebrates 20 years of serving the community. Opening Remarks: Matt Mahan, Mayor, City of San José; Pam Foley, Vice Mayor and District 9 Councilmember, City of San José; Jill Bourne, City Librarian, San José Public Library. Live Entertainment and Activities: Balloon Art giveaway; Special Magic Show by Mr. Shap at 12:00 PM; Arts and Crafts; Spin the Wheel for free prize and Giveaways; Passport Activity, complete minimum of 5 activities to Spin the Wheel or special prize; Friends of Cambrian Library mini book sale; Cake, Treats, and other refreshments. Share Your Story Share your Cambrian Branch story and help us celebrate 20 years by telling us about a favorite memory, experience, or special moment. Did you know? Cambrian Branch is home to Cambrian Beeline, a public artwork featuring stainless steel panels with glass and bronze sculptures inspired by the area's orchards, local history, and themes of exploration and discovery. Stop by and check it out during your next visit. Special Thanks: This event has been generously sponsored and made possible by Friends of Cambrian Library.

events.title: TeenHQ Theater Performance: Maul of the Dead

cases.refreshed: Are you ready for the Zombie Apocalypse? That's okay. We aren't either…but it's happening on Saturday, November 21st in TeenHQ! Be transported to an alternate timeline where the undead roam. Join a ragtag group of strangers as they hideout in a mall department store surrounded by the weirdest, brain-eating zombies you'll ever have the displeasure to meet. You're in for a gory good time. Reserve your seats or just show up for TeenHQ's 18th production, Maul OF THE Dead by Mitch Brian. Concession stand treats will be served while supplies last. Support live theater! This show is open to a 10 years-of-age+ audience, but parental discretion is strongly advised. Registration is recommended, but drop-in audiences are welcome. Maul OF THE Dead written by Mitch Brian was produced by special arrangement with THE Dramatic Publishing Company of Woodstock, Illinois.

Each week of STEM brings a new set of tasks to challenge us. Each week of STEM brings a new set of tasks to challenge us. cases.refreshed: Tuesday, December 1, 7 PM Room 201 Bel Canto Flutes is an all flute ensemble featuring flutes of all shapes and sizes. Bel Canto Flutes enjoys showing off the beauty and flexibility of the flute performing repertoire that spans the ages and genres. Our program for you will feature melodies both familiar and new with antidotes about the music, composers and origins. Come join us as we share our joy of music making with you. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org.
